In this video, I’m breaking down 8 common habits that keep you stuck in a cycle of overspending, plus the simple mindset shifts that can help you shop more intentionally. From impulse buying and sale traps to the subtle pressures of social media, these are the habits I’ve reflected on and learned to change over time.

Whether you’re trying to save money, be more mindful, or just get honest about your spending habits, I hope this gives you something to think about 💸.

snippet.title: I Spent 1 Day Using Money Making Apps
snippet.description:
I Spent 1 Day Using Money Making Apps and you won't believe how much I made...

How I Started My First Business at 15 Years Old:
https://youtu.be/i2n4otfSyNI

In this video I challenge myself to test the whole concept of making money online through apps on your phone. I have seen countless videos from others promoting these apps, so I decided to see if they were legit or not. The apps I used pay based on filling out surveys and doing other tasks. There were many survey apps, however not many apps were a great source for making money online. If you want to make a lot of money online, I suggest you learn a high income online skill such as graphic design on photoshop, coding, social media marketing or facebook advertising. The best online business to start if you want to make real money though, is a Shopify Dropshipping, SMMA or Amazon FBA business. 

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ecombaxter
